record.source_text: (2) If the amendment or supplementation of the wage tax card by entering a past date has retroactive effect (subsection 1), then, apart from cases of an assessment, in the course of carrying out an annual adjustment (Section 72), the wage tax withheld in excess shall be refunded and the wage tax withheld insufficiently shall be subsequently demanded.
